tasks.label: Run on active iOS simulator
tasks.command: ACTIVE_SIM_UDID=$(xcrun simctl list devices booted | awk -F '[()]' '/iPhone|iPad/ { print $2; exit }') && if [ -z "$ACTIVE_SIM_UDID" ]; then echo 'No booted iOS simulator found.'; exit 1; fi && dotnet build -t:Run -f net10.0-ios -p:_DeviceName=:v2:udid=$ACTIVE_SIM_UDID
